env.sandboxHint: Sees only its own work directory and the project's package cache, not other sessions
env.selfHostedHint: For when it must be a particular computer: runs directly on it, without isolation, and can see and operate the whole computer
env.noDeviceOfMine: You have not enrolled a computer of your own
env.ownerOnly: Only the computer's owner can choose it
env.sessionHint: Changes only this AI teammate; the others are not affected. It first pushes its changes to its branch, and changes either way; the changes as of each turn's end are kept in a snapshot.
env.notStarted: Not started yet; it will use the default for new sessions
env.defaultHint: Only affects AI teammates that start from now on; those already running keep their own environment.
